name: David Boies

summary.text: David Boies is a litigator and chairman of Boies, Schiller & Flexner. According to John Carreyrou's reporting, Boies became outside counsel to Theranos after two Palo Alto investors approached him in 2011 and also sat on the Theranos board; his firm was reported, on the account of one unnamed source, to have been paid in Theranos stock for patent work. Theranos, through Boies, pursued former employees Tyler Shultz and Erika Cheung with legal threats after they raised concerns about the company's testing.

openQuestions: The site says Boies Schiller received '$30M+ in fees and stock'. The only source found says the firm was paid in stock for patent work, on one unnamed source's account; no dollar figure was located. Unsupported as to the amount.
The underlying Wall Street Journal articles by John Carreyrou (2015–2016) were not reachable; the facts here rest on a secondary summary and should be checked against them.
